g2-implement.imperative: Fill templates/IMPLEMENTER_HANDOFF.template.md for this gate: (1) extend record() in scripts/checklist_engine.py (survey verb, invariant-check path -- our fence, not workstream B's rendering path) to evaluate any `command`-kind postconditions on the item being recorded, mirroring advance()'s existing postcondition check at line ~1699: when result=='pass' is requested and a command postcondition's check fails (nonzero exit), REFUSE (raise EngineError naming the failing command/gate), the same refusal shape start()/advance() already use; result=='fail' does not require the guard to have passed. (3) Same shape for `r6-fowler` in skills/reviewer/templates/REVIEW_SURVEY.template.json calling `python scripts/verify_fowler_pass.py <fowler-pass-record-path>`. (4) Land tests: extend/add tests/test_record_postcondition_wiring.py proving (a) record(iid, result='pass') on an item with a passing command postcondition succeeds, (b) record(iid, result='pass') REFUSES when the command postcondition fails (deliberate breakage: feed verify_interrogation.py a self-answered decision, and verify_fowler_pass.py a record with a skipped smell, in a scratch temp record file -- never the shared checkout), (c) record(iid, result='fail') is never blocked by a failing command postcondition.
